_comment: Rockchip RKNPU (RK3588 NPU) artifact manifest. The sidecar serves only the files listed here, model files and label files alike, and refuses one whose bytes differ from the digest fetch-models.sh recorded in models.installed.json (a structured model_sha_mismatch, never a silent load; a file with no record is served and reported as unverified). Nothing is pinned in this file: fetch-models.sh resolves the NEWEST non-draft release of each GitHub repo under "sources" at run time (airockchip/rknn-toolkit2 for the runtime, airockchip/rknn_model_zoo for the label files, test images and the zoo's ONNX download links), reads the publisher's digest from the GitHub API (the git blob id of each file at that release's tag) or from the Hugging Face tree API (lfs.oid of the timm weights at main), verifies the downloaded bytes against it, and records {file, digest, publisher_digest, size, source, fetched_at}. The zoo's ONNX files come from the zoo's own download host, which publishes no digest: the script reads the link from the zoo's download_model.sh and records the sha256 it observed. Nothing is redistributed by this repository. Licences of what you download or build (operator order 2026-09-30: no licence costs, so no AGPL or GPL model ships): PP-YOLOE+ s, the detector, is PaddleDetection's weights (Apache-2.0); ResNet-50, the classifier, is torchvision's IMAGENET1K_V2 weights as packaged by timm resnet50.tv2_in1k (BSD-3-Clause); CLIP ViT-B/32 is OpenAI's (MIT); the toolkit, runtime and zoo files are Rockchip's (zoo code Apache-2.0; the toolkit carries a warranty disclaimer and no output restriction). No model here has a public .rknn: fetch-models.sh --convert builds each one from the recipe under its "convert" key on an x86_64 host and records the sha256 of what it built; copy the .rknn files and models.installed.json to the board. A conversion is not bit-reproducible (two runs on identical inputs differ by about a kilobyte of embedded build metadata, measured 2026-09-30), so a record names the exact file that was built. Measured on an RK3588S board on 2026-09-30 with the files built then: ppyoloe_s INT8 mAP 0.4255 over 500 COCO val2017 images (host FP32 0.4360), resnet50tv2-i8 top-1 69.7 % and resnet50tv2-fp16 69.9 % over 1000 ImageNetV2 images (FP32 69.9). The calibration images of the INT8 files are photographs under their per-image Flickr terms, used only to compute quantisation scales and never redistributed: ppyoloe_s is calibrated on the 200 COCO val2017 images of the coco_val2017_calib_200 list (a file in this repository, calib/, fetched image by image from images.cocodataset.org over plain http because the host's https certificate does not match its name, measured 2026-09-30); resnet50tv2-i8 was calibrated on 200 ImageNetV2 images when it was measured (see its calibrated_on). Every model runs on the NPU only: RKNPU_ENABLED=0 stubs the device, there is no CPU fallback.

convert.calibrated_on: the file measured on 2026-09-30 was calibrated on 200 ImageNetV2 (matched-frequency) images, not on this COCO list: a rebuild with this recipe calibrates on COCO, and a conversion is never bit-reproducible
